essence: Relation's counterfeits are refused one by one — awaiting, two-seatedness, uninterruptedness need a consciousness they deny — until form-fusion stands: the many's one-selfhood (vv1-5).
The Buddhist proof-text is turned against its makers: unmixed things thought-joined is no mere thought but unwardable shining-clinging, warrantable in recognition's path (vv6-9).

sections.SUMMARY: Relation whose self is difference-and-non-difference proves all things; world-traffic is his work — Śiva, by own will, praised. His body dawns made of relation: conquering though one, world-self, light, supreme Lord. Awaiting and dependence are no relation for the two inert — impossible; won selfhood or not, metaphor, not definition. Teaching self-obtaining to non-beings drops two-seatedness: form-fusion alone stands as relation's sense. No unbroken nearness — it misses relation; else iron bars. So the many's form-fusion: one-selfhood alone. Others say the many need no barring in oneness: things unmixed, thought joins them. No mere thought, this — past warding, like snake-error clinging to a shining. Clinging is no thing-like-shining but trailing after it: error, that shining strayed. So many-seen-as-one finds warrant — statable, told clear in recognition's path.
sections.FUNCTION: Opens with praise and thesis, refuses three counterfeit relations, then turns the Buddhist proof-text through unwardability and shining-clinging to a warrant inside recognition.
sections.KEY TERMS: bhedābheda (unity-in-diversity) · svecchā (own will) · apekṣā/pāratantrya (awaiting/dependence) · dviṣṭhatā (two-seatedness) · rūpasaṃśleṣa (form-fusion) · aikātmya (one-selfhood) · kalpanā (thought) · ābhāsalagnatva (shining-clinging) · vācyopapatti (statable warrant)
sections.LOCAL CONTEXT: Sambandhasiddhi, Utpaladeva (10th c.), mūla-ślokas with mūla-prose (Muktabodha M00080, KSTS 34). Third proof: relation must be real. Passage 1 of 3: vv. 1–9.
sections.EXPLANATION: Praise, thesis, three refusals with counterexamples, proof-text admitted then turned, warrant claimed in recognition; prose carries the full demolition, verses its theses.
sections.BOUNDARY: v01 feminine referent open. svecchayā agency open. kha bhedātma logged. asaṃbandhāt sense identical either parse. Paratext excluded.

rasa.sthayibhava: utsāha (exultation) as each counterfeit falls and the proof-text turns witness
rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is exultation: three refusals, then the opponent's verse testifying against itself. The vyabhicāri is wonder that joining was never mere thought. Śāstric triumph-relish: truth winning by the adversary's own words.
